title: चतुरधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 104 · Dealing with enemies, mild and fierce

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks how a king should act toward an enemy, whether mild or fierce, and Bhishma recalls Brihaspati's instruction to Indra. He says that one should not at once destroy an enemy, but wait, win by cleverness, and not attack many at the same time.
summary.kn: ಶತ್ರುವಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮೃದು ಅಥವಾ ತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣ ವರ್ತನೆ ಹೇಗೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಇಂದ್ರನಿಗೆ ಬೃಹಸ್ಪತಿ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದನ್ನು ನೆನೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಶತ್ರುವನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ನಾಶ ಮಾಡದೆ ಕಾದು ಚಾಣಾಕ್ಷತೆಯಿಂದ ಗೆಲ್ಲಬೇಕು, ಒಮ್ಮೆಗೇ ಹಲವರ ಮೇಲೆ ದಾಳಿ ಮಾಡಬಾರದೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि राजा शत्रु के प्रति मृदु या कठोर कैसे व्यवहार करे, और भीष्म इन्द्र को बृहस्पति के उपदेश को याद करते हैं। वे कहते हैं कि शत्रु को तुरन्त नष्ट न करे बल्कि प्रतीक्षा कर चतुराई से जीते और एक साथ बहुतों पर आक्रमण न करे।
summary.te: శత్రువు పట్ల మృదువుగా లేదా కఠినంగా ఎలా ప్రవర్తించాలని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు; భీష్ముడు ఇంద్రునికి బృహస్పతి చెప్పినదాన్ని గుర్తు చేస్తాడు. శత్రువును వెంటనే నాశనం చేయక వేచి ఉండి తెలివితో గెలవాలని, ఒకేసారి అనేకులపై దాడి చేయకూడదంటాడు.
summary.ta: பகைவனிடம் மென்மையாகவா கடுமையாகவா நடப்பது என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, இந்திரனுக்குப் பிருகஸ்பதி கூறியதைப் பீஷ்மர் நினைவுகூர்கிறார். பகைவனை உடனே அழிக்காமல் காத்திருந்து சூழ்ச்சியால் வெல்ல வேண்டும், ஒரே நேரத்தில் பலரைத் தாக்கக்கூடாது என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ശത്രുവിനോട് രാജാവ് മൃദുവായോ കഠിനമായോ പെരുമാറേണ്ടതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; ഇന്ദ്രനോട് ബൃഹസ്പതി പറഞ്ഞ ഉപദേശം ഭീഷ്മർ ഓർമ്മിപ്പിക്കുന്നു. ശത്രുവിനെ ഉടനടി നശിപ്പിക്കരുതെന്നും, കാത്തിരുന്ന് ബുദ്ധികൊണ്ട് ജയിക്കണമെന്നും, ഒരേസമയം പലരെയും ആക്രമിക്കരുതെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.104; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
कथं मृदौ कथं तीक्ष्णे महापक्षे च पार्थिव ।
अरौ वर्तेत नृपतिस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: How should a king deal with an enemy who is mild, who is fierce, or who has a great party? Tell me, grandfather.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
बृहस्पतेश्च संवादमिन्द्रस्य च युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: On this they recount an old story, the conversation of Brihaspati and Indra, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
बृहस्पतिं देवपतिरभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः ।
उपसंगम्य पप्रच्छ वासवः परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: Vasava, lord of the gods and slayer of enemy heroes, bowed to Brihaspati with folded hands, approached him and asked:

verses.text:
अहितेषु कथं ब्रह्मन्वर्तयेयमतन्द्रितः ।
असमुच्छिद्य चैवेनान्नियच्छेयमुपायतः ॥

meaning.en: 'Brahmin, how should I act, unwearied, toward my enemies, and restrain them by skilful means without uprooting them?

verses.text:
सेनयोर्व्यतिषङ्गेण जयः साधारणो भवेत् ।
किं कुर्वाणं न मां जह्याज्ज्वलिता श्रीः प्रतापिनी ॥

meaning.en: 'When armies clash, victory may be shared; what should I do so that blazing, glorious fortune does not leave me?'

verses.text:
ततो धर्मार्थकामानां कुशलः प्रतिभानवान् ।
राजधर्मविधानज्ञः प्रत्युवाच पुरंदरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Brihaspati, skilled in dharma, wealth and desire, ready-witted and knowing the rules of kingship, replied to Indra:

verses.text:
न जातु कलहेनेच्छेन्नियन्तुमपकारिणः ।
बालसंसेवितं ह्येतद्यदमर्षो यदक्षमा ।
न शत्रुर्विवृतः कार्यो वधमस्याभिकाङ्क्षता ॥

meaning.en: 'Never try to subdue wrongdoers by quarrel; wrath and impatience are the habits of children. One who wants to destroy an enemy should not make him openly an enemy.

verses.text:
क्रोधं बलममर्षं च नियम्यात्मजमात्मनि ।
अमित्रमुपसेवेत विश्वस्तवदविश्वसन् ॥

meaning.en: 'Holding anger, strength and impatience born in oneself within oneself, one should serve the enemy and, though distrusting, seem to trust him.

verses.text:
प्रियमेव वदेन्नित्यं नाप्रियं किंचिदाचरेत् ।
विरमेच्छुष्कवैरेभ्यः कण्ठायासं च वर्जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'Always speak pleasantly and do nothing unpleasant; avoid dry quarrels and avoid straining the throat.

verses.text:
यथा वैतंसिको युक्तो द्विजानां सदृशस्वनः ।
तान्द्विजान्कुरुते वश्यांस्तथा युक्तो महीपतिः ।
वशं चोपनयेच्छत्रून्निहन्याच्च पुरंदर ॥

meaning.en: 'As a fowler, skilled, imitates the cries of birds and brings them under his power, so should a prudent king; he should bring enemies under his sway and then slay them, Purandara.

verses.text:
न नित्यं परिभूयारीन्सुखं स्वपिति वासव ।
जागर्त्येव च दुष्टात्मा संकरेऽग्निरिवोत्थितः ॥

meaning.en: 'He who is always scorning his foes, Vasava, does not sleep in comfort; the wicked man stays awake like a fire that has risen in a haystack.

verses.text:
न संनिपातः कर्तव्यः सामान्ये विजये सति ।
विश्वास्यैवोपसंन्यास्यो वशे कृत्वा रिपुः प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: 'Do not meet in battle when victory is only shared; having gained the enemy's trust and brought him under control, he may be put to the sword, lord.

verses.text:
संप्रधार्य सहामात्यैर्मन्त्रविद्भिर्महात्मभिः ।
उपेक्षमाणोऽवज्ञाते हृदयेनापराजितः ॥

meaning.en: 'Having consulted with ministers who know counsel and are great-souled, he should ignore the foe's slights, unbeaten in heart.

verses.text:
अथास्य प्रहरेत्काले किंचिद्विचलिते पदे ।
दण्डं च दूषयेदस्य पुरुषैराप्तकारिभिः ॥

meaning.en: 'Then, when the foe's foot slips a little, he should strike in season, and spoil the enemy's army through trusted agents.

verses.text:
आदिमध्यावसानज्ञः प्रच्छन्नं च विचारयेत् ।
बलानि दूषयेदस्य जानंश्चैव प्रमाणतः ॥

meaning.en: 'Knowing beginning, middle and end, he should reflect in secret and corrupt the enemy's forces, knowing them exactly.

verses.text:
भेदेनोपप्रदानेन संसृजन्नौषधैस्तथा ।
न त्वेव चेलसंसर्गं रचयेदरिभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: 'By division, gifts and drugs he should mingle with them, but never form a close tie of dress with enemies.

verses.text:
दीर्घकालमपि क्षान्त्वा विहन्यादेव शात्रवान् ।
कालाकाङ्क्षी यामयेच्च यथा विस्रम्भमाप्नुयुः ॥

meaning.en: 'Even after bearing long, he should still destroy his foes; waiting for time, he should keep them moving until they gain confidence.

verses.text:
न सद्योऽरीन्विनिर्हन्याद्दृष्टस्य विजयोऽज्वरः ।
न यः शल्यं घट्टयति नवं च कुरुते व्रणम् ॥

meaning.en: 'He should not kill enemies at once; victory comes without fever to one who is careful. He does not prod the dart or make a fresh wound.

verses.text:
प्राप्ते च प्रहरेत्काले न स संवर्तते पुनः ।
हन्तुकामस्य देवेन्द्र पुरुषस्य रिपुं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: 'He strikes when the time comes, and it does not return again, for the man who longs to kill his enemy, lord of the gods.

verses.text:
यः कालो हि व्यतिक्रामेत्पुरुषं कालकाङ्क्षिणम् ।
दुर्लभः स पुनः कालः कालधर्मचिकीर्षुणा ॥

meaning.en: 'The moment that passes by one who is waiting for it is hard to find again for one who wishes to act as the moment demands.

verses.text:
और्जस्थ्यं विजयेदेवं संगृह्णन्साधुसंमतान् ।
कालेन साधयेन्नित्यं नाप्राप्तेऽभिनिपीडयेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'So, winning over those esteemed by good men, he should overcome the enemy's vigour. By timely means he should always succeed, and not press before the time has come.

verses.text:
विहाय कामं क्रोधं च तथाहंकारमेव च ।
युक्तो विवरमन्विच्छेदहितानां पुरंदर ॥

meaning.en: 'Giving up desire, anger and pride, Purandara, he should attend and look for the enemy's weak point.

verses.text:
मार्दवं दण्ड आलस्यं प्रमादश्च सुरोत्तम ।
मायाश्च विविधाः शक्र साधयन्त्यविचक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Mildness, force, laziness, carelessness and various deceptions, Indra, defeat the unwise.

verses.text:
निहत्यैतानि चत्वारि मायां प्रतिविधाय च ।
ततः शक्नोति शत्रूणां प्रहर्तुमविचारयन् ॥

meaning.en: 'Having destroyed these four and guarded against deceit, he is then able to strike his enemies without hesitation.

verses.text:
यदैवैकेन शक्येत गुह्यं कर्तुं तदाचरेत् ।
यच्छन्ति सचिवा गुह्यं मिथो विद्रावयन्त्यपि ॥

meaning.en: 'When a secret can be kept by one man alone, let him do so; for ministers who are given a secret may leak it to one another.

verses.text:
अशक्यमिति कृत्वा वा ततोऽन्यैः संविदं चरेत् ।
ब्रह्मदण्डमदृष्टेषु दृष्टेषु चतुरङ्गिणीम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Or, thinking it impossible, he should then deal with others; use the Brahmin's rod against the unseen, and the four-fold army against the seen.

verses.text:
भेदं च प्रथमं युञ्ज्यात्तूष्णींदण्डं तथैव च ।
काले प्रयोजयेद्राजा तस्मिंस्तस्मिंस्तदा तदा ॥

meaning.en: 'First employ division and silent punishment; a king should apply each at its own time.

verses.text:
प्रणिपातं च गच्छेत काले शत्रोर्बलीयसः ।
युक्तोऽस्य वधमन्विच्छेदप्रमत्तः प्रमाद्यतः ॥

meaning.en: 'He should bow even to a stronger enemy in season, and while attentive, look for the chance to slay him as he grows careless.

verses.text:
प्रणिपातेन दानेन वाचा मधुरया ब्रुवन् ।
अमित्रमुपसेवेत न तु जातु विशङ्कयेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'With bowing, gifts and sweet speech he should serve the enemy, yet never put away suspicion.

verses.text:
स्थानानि शङ्कितानां च नित्यमेव विवर्जयेत् ।
न च तेष्वाश्वसेद्द्रुग्ध्वा जाग्रतीह निराकृताः ॥

meaning.en: 'He should always avoid places of suspected danger, and not trust them after betraying others, for those cast out remain awake.

verses.text:
न ह्यतो दुष्करं कर्म किंचिदस्ति सुरोत्तम ।
यथा विविधवृत्तानामैश्वर्यममराधिप ॥

meaning.en: 'Nothing is harder, best of gods, than the lordship of men of diverse conduct, lord of the immortals.

verses.text:
तथा विविधशीलानामपि संभव उच्यते ।
यतेत योगमास्थाय मित्रामित्रानवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: 'Likewise it is said to arise among those of diverse temper; he should strive, holding to yoga, without driving away friends or enemies.

verses.text:
मृदुमप्यवमन्यन्ते तीक्ष्णादुद्विजते जनः ।
मातीक्ष्णो मामृदुर्भूस्त्वं तीक्ष्णो भव मृदुर्भव ॥

meaning.en: 'People despise even a mild man and shrink from a harsh one; so be neither too harsh nor too mild: be harsh, be mild.

verses.text:
यथा वप्रे वेगवति सर्वतःसंप्लुतोदके ।
नित्यं विवरणाद्बाधस्तथा राज्यं प्रमाद्यतः ॥

meaning.en: 'As an embankment against a swift flood with water on every side is breached by constant opening, so a careless king's kingdom is harmed.

verses.text:
न बहूनभियुञ्जीत यौगपद्येन शात्रवान् ।
साम्ना दानेन भेदेन दण्डेन च पुरंदर ॥

meaning.en: 'Do not attack many enemies at once, Purandara, with conciliation, gifts, division and force.

verses.text:
एकैकमेषां निष्पिंषञ्शिष्टेषु निपुणं चरेत् ।
न च शक्तोऽपि मेधावी सर्वानेवारभेन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: 'Crushing them one by one, he should act skilfully toward the rest; a wise king should not begin against all, even if able.

verses.text:
यदा स्यान्महती सेना हयनागरथाकुला ।
पदातियन्त्रबहुला स्वनुरक्ता षडङ्गिनी ॥

meaning.en: 'When his army is great, full of horses, elephants and chariots, with many foot soldiers and engines, devoted, of six divisions...

verses.text:
यदा बहुविधां वृद्धिं मन्यते प्रतिलोमतः ।
तदा विवृत्य प्रहरेद्दस्यूनामविचारयन् ॥

meaning.en: '...and when he thinks his growth manifold in the reverse of the foe's, then he should openly strike the bandits without hesitation.

verses.text:
न साम दण्डोपनिषत्प्रशस्यते
न मार्दवं शत्रुषु यात्रिकं सदा ।
न सस्यघातो न च संकरक्रिया
न चापि भूयः प्रकृतेर्विचारणा ॥

meaning.en: 'Neither conciliation nor the secret doctrine of force is always praised, nor mildness toward enemies on the march, nor wrecking of crops, nor confusion; nor again reconsidering the subjects.

verses.text:
मायाविभेदानुपसर्जनानि
पापं तथैव स्पशसंप्रयोगात् ।
आप्तैर्मनुष्यैरुपचारयेत
पुरेषु राष्ट्रेषु च संप्रयुक्तः ॥

meaning.en: 'Deceptions, divisions and subversion, and sin by the use of spies: he should have these carried out by trusted men, applied in cities and in the realm.

verses.text:
पुराणि चैषामनुसृत्य भूमिपाः
पुरेषु भोगान्निखिलानिहाजयन् ।
पुरेषु नीतिं विहितां यथाविधि
प्रयोजयन्तो बलवृत्रसूदन ॥

meaning.en: 'Kings, following the enemy's cities, win all their enjoyments in those cities, applying the prescribed policy in the cities by rule, slayer of Bala and Vritra.

verses.text:
प्रदाय गूढानि वसूनि नाम
प्रच्छिद्य भोगानवधाय च स्वान् ।
दुष्टाः स्वदोषैरिति कीर्तयित्वा
पुरेषु राष्ट्रेषु च योजयन्ति ॥

meaning.en: 'They give hidden wealth, cut off the enemy's enjoyments and protect their own, and declare 'These are corrupted by their own faults', and so apply it in cities and realms.

verses.text:
तथैव चान्यै रतिशास्त्रवेदिभिः
स्वलंकृतैः शास्त्रविधानदृष्टिभिः ।
सुशिक्षितैर्भाष्यकथाविशारदैः
परेषु कृत्यानुपधारयस्व ॥

meaning.en: 'And likewise, with others who know the science of love, well adorned, who observe the rules of the texts, well trained and skilled in discourse, find out the enemy's undertakings.'

verses.text: इन्द्र उवाच

meaning.en: Indra said:

verses.text:
कानि लिङ्गानि दुष्टस्य भवन्ति द्विजसत्तम ।
कथं दुष्टं विजानीयादेतत्पृष्टो ब्रवीहि मे ॥

meaning.en: 'Best of Brahmins, what are the marks of a wicked man? How does one recognise the wicked? Tell me, since I ask.'

verses.text: बृहस्पतिरुवाच

meaning.en: Brihaspati said:

verses.text:
परोक्षमगुणानाह सद्गुणानभ्यसूयति ।
परैर्वा कीर्त्यमानेषु तूष्णीमास्ते पराङ्मुखः ॥

meaning.en: 'He speaks of faults behind one's back, resents good qualities, and when others are praised he sits silent, turned away.

verses.text:
तूष्णींभावेऽपि हि ज्ञानं न चेद्भवति कारणम् ।
विश्वासमोष्ठसंदंशं शिरसश्च प्रकम्पनम् ॥

meaning.en: 'And if there is no reason for his silence in knowledge, he shows lack of trust, biting his lip and shaking his head.

verses.text:
करोत्यभीक्ष्णं संसृष्टमसंसृष्टश्च भाषते ।
अदृष्टितो विकुरुते दृष्ट्वा वा नाभिभाषते ॥

meaning.en: 'He often mingles, yet speaks as if not mingled; he is disturbed when unseen, and when he sees you says nothing.

verses.text:
पृथगेत्य समश्नाति नेदमद्य यथाविधि ।
आसने शयने याने भावा लक्ष्या विशेषतः ॥

meaning.en: 'He comes and eats apart, not as is proper today. In sitting, lying and travelling, his feelings may be noted especially.

verses.text:
आर्तिरार्ते प्रिये प्रीतिरेतावन्मित्रलक्षणम् ।
विपरीतं तु बोद्धव्यमरिलक्षणमेव तत् ॥

meaning.en: 'Distress at another's distress and joy at another's joy: this is the mark of a friend. Know the opposite to be the mark of a foe.

verses.text:
एतान्येवं यथोक्तानि बुध्येथास्त्रिदशाधिप ।
पुरुषाणां प्रदुष्टानां स्वभावो बलवत्तरः ॥

meaning.en: 'Know these signs as stated, lord of the thirty gods; in wicked men their nature is stronger than anything.

verses.text:
इति दुष्टस्य विज्ञानमुक्तं ते सुरसत्तम ।
निशाम्य शास्त्रतत्त्वार्थं यथावदमरेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: 'Thus the way to know a wicked man has been told to you, best of gods, lord of the immortals, after hearing the true meaning of the science.'

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
स तद्वचः शत्रुनिबर्हणे रत-
स्तथा चकारावितथं बृहस्पतेः ।
चचार काले विजयाय चारिहा
वशं च शत्रूननयत्पुरंदरः ॥

meaning.en: Intent on destroying his enemies, Indra did exactly what Brihaspati said; slayer of foes, he acted in due season for victory and brought his enemies under his power.
